messages.subject: How to include a R plot as a hyperlink
messages.subject_clean: How to include a R plot as a hyperlink
messages.body_plain: Hi, is it possible to include a R plot that is produced within R markdown and include it as a hyperlink in the final html file. The plot is not shown directly in the final html. Rather there is a hyperlink. Once you click it, the plot will be shown.

messages.body_plain: This is definitely possible, but I don't have time to provide a full answer. At least you could use JavaScript to change to a link and add a click event on it to achieve what you wanted; or set a knitr plot hook to generate the expected : https://bookdown.org/yihui/rmarkdown-cookbook/output-hooks.html I'd recommend that you try other forums such as Stack Overflow or RStudio Community. This mailing list has not really been active for a few years...
